autoimprove_nightly.prompt: Run overnight self-improvement on all skills. Call autoimprove.run_all(5, max_runtime_seconds=3600) — this audits and fixes dynamic skills automatically, and queues suggestions for core skills for the user to review.

kb_nightly_ingest.prompt: Auto-ingest any new or changed documents in /app/memory/knowledge/. Call knowledge_base.ingest_folder() and report how many new documents were indexed. If new documents were added, also notify via telegram_bot.send_message() with a brief summary.

daily_end_of_day.prompt: Write today's end-of-day journal entry. First call notes.get_activity_log(hours=24) to review what was done. Then call notes.end_day(summary='<2-3 sentence summary of today's tasks and outcomes>', next_steps='<any pending items or plans for tomorrow>', user_insights='<what you observed about the user's focus areas or patterns today>'). Be specific and concise — avoid generic filler.

meta_review_weekly.prompt: Run the weekly meta-review synthesis. Call meta_review.weekly_digest(7) and meta_review.loop_roi_report(). Review the output for any critical recommendations (unfixed error types with high counts, low fix coverage). If there are actionable items, call autoimprove.park_idea() for each one. Report a 3-5 line summary of findings.
